keyEvents.text: Goal! Midtjylland 0, Ajax 1. Tolu Arokodare (Ajax) header from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Oscar Gloukh with a cross following a corner.
Goal! Midtjylland 1, Ajax 1. Friday Etim (Midtjylland) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal.
Kjell Wätjen (Midtjylland) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Friday Etim (Midtjylland).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Kjell-Arik Wätjen (FC Midtjylland) Red Card at 43'
